$comment: Copy this to your own file, edit it, and point PINCH_TOOLS at it. Every tool here calls a program you already trust; Pinch never executes this file. Every call stops for your approval, always — there is no 'trusted' flag in this format.

tools.name: git_status_here
tools.description: Show the working tree status of the Pinch checkout: branch, changed files, untracked files.

tools.name: notes_search
tools.description: Search your notes directory for a phrase and return the matching lines with file and line number.

tools.name: disk_free
tools.description: Report free space on the given mount point as one human-readable line.

mount.description: Absolute path of the mount point, e.g. / or /home
